column1: As discussed in chapter 1, commodity prices eliminate the price puzzle in VAR estimates of monetary policy e¤ects because of the informational role they appear to play. See Kareken, Muench, and Wallace (1973) and B. Friedman (1975; 1977b; 1990) for early treatments of the informational role of intermediate targets. More recently, Svensson (1997a; 1999b) stressed the role of inflation forecasts as an intermediate target. Bernanke and Woodford (1997) showed, however, how multiple equilibria may arise if policy is based on private sector forecasts, which are, in turn, based on expectations of future policy.
